# Truth Becomes a Class-Name for Working-Values

The pragmatist clings to facts and concreteness, observes truth at its work in particular cases, and generalizes.[^1] Truth, for him, becomes a class-name for all sorts of definite working-values in experience.[^2] For the rationalist it remains a pure abstraction, to the bare name of which we must defer.[^3]

[^1]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#Rationalistic Criticisms]] "The pragmatist clings to facts and concreteness, observes truth at its work in particular cases, and generalizes."
[^2]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#Rationalistic Criticisms]] "Truth, for him, becomes a class-name for all sorts of definite working-values in experience."
[^3]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#Rationalistic Criticisms]] "For the rationalist it remains a pure abstraction, to the bare name of which we must defer."
